get.description: Returns the electron-builder manifest of the offered release with absolute external download URLs, or a manifest announcing the current version (no update). Never serves binaries.
Optional 'version' returns one release; optional 'since' returns releases newer than that version (e.g. the installed one).

post.summary: Explain the update decision for a hypothetical installation

get.summary: Audit trail, newest first; page with 'before' (the previous page's nextBefore).

put.summary: Replace the platforms the application ships to; dropping one stops new offers to it

delete.summary: Permanently delete a release and everything attached to it so its version can be registered again (admins; confirmVersion must equal the version)

post.summary: Add a platform's manifest to an existing release (e.g. ship macOS after Windows)

get.summary: Preview everything that obliterating the release would permanently delete

AudienceRule.description: One matching condition of an audience.

AudienceRuleAttributeRule.description: Matches a verified custom attribute against a set of allowed values.

AudienceRuleCurrentVersionRule.description: Matches installations whose current version is within [Minimum, MaximumExclusive).

ChangeSupportedPlatformsRequest.description: Replaces the application's supported platforms (separate from UpdateApplicationRequest so edits never clobber each other).

ExplainDecisionRequest.description: Hypothetical installation context to explain. Identity fields are treated as already verified.

ObliterationImpact.description: Everything that would be permanently deleted with a release (issue #12).

PlatformTarget.description: Platform/architecture combination an updater asks for. Windows and macOS metadata cover all architectures in one file.
